title: Security Deposits
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:39 AM
For more information see the section on the Budget Billing Plan component.

Security Deposits

Use

You can request a security deposit in move-in processing, or, provided certain conditions have been met, adopt the security
deposit of an existing contract.

Re-Request Security Deposit
Customizing Settings

In Customizing under |)}Move-In/Out Move-In 's Define Move-In Control Parameters on Contract Level “you can configure the

system so that security deposits are requested through move-in processing.You can request a cash security deposit, or arrange a
non-cash security deposit with the customer.

e Acash security deposit is created for each contract. In doing this, this system posts a request document for a cash security
deposit in FI-CA.

e Anon-cash security deposit is created for all the contracts involved in the move-in, for which a non-cash deposit is to be

created.
Entry Options on the Move-In Screen

On the move-in screen, on the tabstrip Contract Data , enter a reason for requesting the security deposit and the amount
requested. Now, when you save the move-in document, the system automatically creates a security deposit. If you specified a
reason for exempting the customer from a security deposit then one is not created. You can allocate a default value to the security

deposit reason and amount using enhancement EC500001 (determine security deposit reason and amount).

For more information see the section on Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI-CA) including Security Deposits .

Adopt Existing Security Deposits (Transfer)

In Customizing under Define Move-In Control Parameters on Contract Level , you can, using the Security deposits field,
configure the system to transfer the security deposits of existing contracts to newly created contracts. This is done by means of
Transfer Contracts. You can use this procedure if, for example, a business partner moves to a new premise in the supply territory,
terminates his/her existing contracts for this reason and wishes the security deposits paid on these contracts to be adopted for
the new contracts. You can transfer deposits in this way if the following transfer conditions have been met:

e You have entered a move-in/out in the system.

e You have selected the contracts so that both the move-in and move-out documents both contain one contract for each
division, and each have the same number of contracts.

e In Customizing, under Define Move-In Control Parameters on Contract Level , you have defined whether the security
deposits of a contract can be automatically transferred.

e Both the transfer contract and the new contract have been allocated to the same company code.
